title: Multi-granularity window fusion for compact Console analytics aggregates
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact set of curated aggregate tables that fuse multiple time-window granularities (1m, 5m, 1h, 1d) into a storage- and query-efficient layout to support Console real-time and historical dashboards with predictable cost and fast slice-and-dice latency.
motivation: Current Console analytics queries hit large, highly-sparse invocation event tables and rely on expensive ad-hoc aggregation. This leads to high query latency for interactive dashboards and unpredictable Snowflake/BigQuery costs. A multi-granularity fusion approach reduces scanned data and materializes common rollups while preserving the ability to derive arbitrary time windows via compact combining logic.
proposed_solution: 1) Define a fused aggregate schema that stores canonical keys (workspace_id, route_id, model_variant, tenant_tier) and pre-aggregated metrics at four canonical windows (1m, 5m, 1h, 1d) in columnar-friendly layout. 2) Implement a daily and hourly ETL that computes deltas and merges into the fused aggregates using time-bucket compaction to avoid duplication. 3) Add query-time helper UDFs that reconstruct arbitrary windows by combining the canonical buckets with minimal scans. 4) Expose the fused tables to Console dashboards and use them as the default source for per-route latency/cost heatmaps and SLA slices.
schema_changes: Create table analytics.fused_invocation_agg_fused_v1 with columns: workspace_id TEXT, route_id TEXT, model_variant TEXT, tenant_tier TEXT, bucket_start TIMESTAMP, bucket_granularity STRING, invocation_count BIGINT, token_count BIGINT, sum_latency_ms DOUBLE, p95_latency_ms DOUBLE, error_count BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMP
Partition by bucket_granularity and bucket_start (date) and cluster by workspace_id, route_id
Add metadata table analytics.fused_agg_version for schema and lineage tracking
migration_plan: Backfill last 90 days via backfill job running in staging first (estimated 48h on infra)
Run validation checks comparing sampled results with existing canonical sessionization marts (row-level and aggregate diffs <0.5%)
Promote fused tables to prod read-only; switch Console dashboards to query fused tables behind a feature flag
Monitor cost/latency for 2 weeks, then schedule final cutover and retire older denormalized daily marts if savings validated
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Create schema and backfill in analytics-dev (1 week)
Phase 1: Backfill 90 days in staging and run automated regression tests (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Enable feature flag for non-critical Console panels and shadow traffic (1 week)
Phase 3: Gradual rollout to critical dashboards and route-level queries; monitor SLOs (2 weeks)
Phase 4: Full cutover and decommission old marts (1 week)
acceptance_criteria: Average interactive dashboard query latency for top-10 route slices reduced by >=40% compared to baseline
Monthly query scanned bytes for Console dashboards reduced by >=35%
Aggregate values (invocation_count, token_count, error_count) match canonical marts within 0.5% across sampled time windows
Feature-flagged rollout validated with no functional regressions in 2 weeks of production shadow traffic
test_plan: Unit tests for ETL transform logic and UDF combining functions
Integration tests that run full hourly and daily jobs on a small tenancy sample
End-to-end dashboard smoke tests verifying expected panels and percentile approximations
Cost simulation comparing query scanned bytes before/after on historical query traces
tasks: Design fused table schema and write DDLs
Implement hourly ETL job in Airflow (Spark/DBT task) with idempotent merge logic
Implement daily compaction job to collapse small 1m buckets into 5m where applicable
Create UDFs for reconstructing arbitrary windows from canonical buckets
Build backfill orchestration with resource throttling
Create validation suite and dashboards for roll forward/back checks
Instrument cost/latency alerts and add to Console SLO dashboard
Update docs and provide runbook for operators
kpis: Monthly scanned bytes for Console workspace queries (GB)
Storage cost delta for fused aggregates vs previous marts
risks: Aggregation divergence: minor numerical differences due to bucketing and approximate percentile aggregation
Backfill resource contention causing interference with other analytics jobs
Edge cases in tenant_tier cardinality causing uneven partition sizes
Query semantics mismatch for ad-hoc analyst queries expecting raw event-level fidelity
notes: We intentionally keep four canonical granularities to balance reconstruction complexity and storage. If adoption and savings are strong, we may add a compact sketch column for approximate percentiles to further shrink storage. Coordinate with infra to schedule backfills during off-peak billing windows.
